description: Recorded reasons for unverified items that exist only when a resident runtime is staged (PACKAGED). Read in addition to unverified-allowlist.json only then. This file gates nothing (owner decision P-09); a reason is a record, not legal sign-off.

entries.name: Node.js runtime (libeliza_node.so)
entries.reason: Node.js is MIT-licensed, but the Android build statically links the third-party components its LICENSE file lists (V8, libuv, OpenSSL, ICU, llhttp, zlib, brotli, c-ares and others) under their own licences. The per-component notices and any source offer for this pinned build have not been reviewed.
